title: Ask HN: AI and Math
excerpt: Knowing whether something or true or isn't true is useful for other lines of inquiry, often practical. For example, a lot could be gained by determining whether P = NP.
content_html:
Knowing whether something or true or isn't true is useful for other lines of inquiry, often practical. For example, a lot could be gained by determining whether P = NP.

Also an initial, cumbersome, complex proof is the first step to a more understandable, formalized proof. AI created a formal proof of Fermat's last theorem. I'm sure the initial proof was not comprehensible to all but a small subset of mathematicians anyway.
